summary: Tested streaming chat functionality for BridgeBot. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing confirmed streaming works on both ChatPage and ChatWidget with proper SSE event handling, button/input state management, and reset functionality.

ui_bugs.issue: Send button disabled prop only checks isLoading, not isStreaming. Button should be disabled during both states.
ui_bugs.note: Not critical - sendMessage function has guard clause for isStreaming, and input is cleared after send

action_items: OPTIONAL: Update ChatPage.js send button disabled prop to include isStreaming: disabled={isLoading || isStreaming || !input.trim()}
critical_code_review_comments: Streaming implementation is well-structured with proper SSE event format (session, token, done, error events)
streamChat.js utility correctly handles SSE parsing with buffer management for incomplete lines
Both ChatPage and ChatWidget properly manage streaming state with isLoading and isStreaming flags
Error handling in stream_chat_response properly yields error events for HTTPException and general exceptions
The Emergent provider path correctly uses _simulate_stream() to yield word-by-word chunks after full LLM response
seed_data_creation: Test API key created with label 'TEST_streaming_key' for external API testing (auto-cleaned)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Streaming endpoints are POST /api/chat/stream (web) and POST /api/v1/chat/stream (external API with bbk_ key). SSE events are: session (with session_id), token (with token), done (with full_response), error (with message). Response time is 5-10 seconds due to Emergent LLM processing before simulated streaming begins.
